recognize_zh: 中倍（20x）TRAP 染色中，大型 Gaucher 細胞的細胞質呈強烈深棕色陽性，成片或呈漩渦狀聚集於骨小梁間；周圍小型造血細胞為藍色陰性，對比清楚，代表 Gaucher 細胞高度表現抗酒石酸酸性磷酸酶。
features: Large cells with abundant cytoplasm showing strong granular to diffuse brown TRAP positivity
Positive cells form confluent sheets and swirling clusters between trabeculae
Small residual hematopoietic cells are negative (blue hematoxylin counterstain)
Bony trabecula along the left edge
Individual cell outlines partially obscured by intense staining
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine section stained for tartrate-resistant acid phosphatase shows clusters and sheets of large cells with strong brown cytoplasmic TRAP positivity, interspersed with negative small hematopoietic cells. The positive cells correspond to the Gaucher cell infiltrate seen on H&E. TRAP positivity is characteristic of Gaucher cells but is shared by osteoclasts and hairy cells. Findings are consistent with Gaucher disease with extensive marrow involvement, pending enzymatic or genetic confirmation.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells are also TRAP positive but are small to medium cells with oval nuclei and fried-egg appearance, and are CD20, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E positive.
Osteoclasts are TRAP positive but are multinucleated and located along bone surfaces in Howship lacunae, not as interstitial sheets.
Pseudo-Gaucher cells in CML or myeloma can also be TRAP positive, so the clinical context, background marrow and glucocerebrosidase activity are needed.
